result_text:
The Duplication report now has a "Most Frequent Duplicates" section right after "Longest Duplicates", and its code fragments are saved when `saveCodeFragments` is on. The `codeanalyzer` duplication test passes (2/2) and the `reports` module compiles; it has no duplication tests of its own, so the report output itself is not exercised. I did not commit.

Changes:

- **`reports/.../generators/statichtml/DuplicationReportGenerator.java`**: `addMostFrequentDuplicatesList` already existed but was never called. It is now called right after the longest duplicates. It is skipped when the list is empty.
- **`reports/.../dataexporters/DataExporter.java`**:
  - Saves the fragments as `fragments/most_frequent_duplicates/most_frequent_duplicates_<n>.<ext>` when `saveCodeFragments` is on.
  - Adds the files of the most frequent duplicates to the referenced-files set, so the Files column links work when source files are saved, as they already do for the longest duplicates.
- **`codeanalyzer/.../analysis/files/DuplicationAnalyzer.java`**: this is a fix beyond the literal request. `addMostFrequentDuplicates` sorted a throwaway copy of the list, so the "most frequent" entries were just the first results with more than two copies, not the ones with the most copies. It now sorts a local copy and takes the top entries from that. This changes which duplicates appear in the analysis results, so drop this hunk if you want the analyzer left as it was.
